query:

UNION ALL
SELECT 'house', state_code, candidate1_name, candidate2_name FROM house_races WHERE candidate1_name LIKE '%Cooper%' OR candidate2_name LIKE '%Cooper%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'governor', state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate FROM governor_races WHERE dem_candidate LIKE '%Cooper%' OR rep_candidate LIKE '%Cooper%';
